rocksdb_advise_random_on_open.desc: DBOptions::advise_random_on_open for RocksDB (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-advise-random-on-open to disable.)

rocksdb_allow_to_start_after_corruption.desc: Allow server to start successfully when RocksDB corruption is detected.

rocksdb_allow_unsafe_alter.desc: Enable crash unsafe INPLACE ADD|DROP partition.

rocksdb_alter_column_default_inplace.desc: Allow inplace alter for alter column default operation (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-alter-column-default-inplace to disable.)

rocksdb_blind_delete_primary_key.desc: Deleting rows by primary key lookup, without reading rows (Blind Deletes). Blind delete is disabled if the table has secondary key

rocksdb_bulk_load.desc: Use bulk-load mode for inserts. This disables unique_checks and enables rocksdb_commit_in_the_middle.

rocksdb_bulk_load_allow_sk.desc: Allow bulk loading of sk keys during bulk-load. Can be changed only when bulk load is disabled.

rocksdb_bulk_load_allow_unsorted.desc: Allow unsorted input during bulk-load. Can be changed only when bulk load is disabled.

rocksdb_bulk_load_partial_index.desc: Materialize partial index during bulk load, instead of leaving it empty. (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-bulk-load-partial-index to disable.)

rocksdb_bulk_load_size.desc: Max #records in a batch for bulk-load mode

rocksdb_cache_dump.desc: Include RocksDB block cache content in core dump. (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-cache-dump to disable.)

rocksdb_cache_high_pri_pool_ratio.desc: Specify the size of block cache high-pri pool

rocksdb_cache_index_and_filter_blocks.desc: BlockBasedTableOptions::cache_index_and_filter_blocks for RocksDB (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-cache-index-and-filter-blocks to disable.)

rocksdb_cache_index_and_filter_with_high.desc: cache_index_and_filter_blocks_with_high_priority for RocksDB (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-cache-index-and-filter-with-high-priority to disable.)

rocksdb_checksums_pct.desc: How many percentages of rows to be checksummed

rocksdb_collect_sst_properties.desc: Enables collecting SST file properties on each flush (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-collect-sst-properties to disable.)

rocksdb_commit_in_the_middle.desc: Commit rows implicitly every rocksdb_bulk_load_size, on bulk load/insert, update and delete

rocksdb_compaction_sequential_deletes.desc: RocksDB will trigger compaction for the file if it has more than this number sequential deletes per window

rocksdb_compaction_sequential_deletes_fi.desc: Minimum file size required for compaction_sequential_deletes

rocksdb_compaction_sequential_deletes_wi.desc: Size of the window for counting rocksdb_compaction_sequential_deletes

rocksdb_concurrent_prepare.deprecated: DEPRECATED, use rocksdb_two_write_queries instead. (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-concurrent-prepare to disable.)
rocksdb_concurrent_prepare.desc: DEPRECATED, use rocksdb_two_write_queries instead. (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-concurrent-prepare to disable.)

rocksdb_create_if_missing.desc: DBOptions::create_if_missing for RocksDB (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-create-if-missing to disable.)

rocksdb_deadlock_detect_depth.desc: Number of transactions deadlock detection will traverse through before assuming deadlock

rocksdb_debug_manual_compaction_delay.desc: For debugging purposes only. Sleeping specified seconds for simulating long running compactions.

rocksdb_debug_optimizer_no_zero_cardinal.desc: In case if cardinality is zero, overrides it with some value (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-debug-optimizer-no-zero-cardinality to disable.)

rocksdb_debug_ttl_ignore_pk.desc: For debugging purposes only. If true, compaction filtering will not occur on PK TTL data. This variable is a no-op in non-debug builds.

rocksdb_debug_ttl_read_filter_ts.desc: For debugging purposes only.  Overrides the TTL read filtering time to time + debug_ttl_read_filter_ts. A value of 0 denotes that the variable is not set. This variable is a no-op in non-debug builds.

rocksdb_debug_ttl_rec_ts.desc: For debugging purposes only.  Overrides the TTL of records to now() + debug_ttl_rec_ts.  The value can be +/- to simulate a record inserted in the past vs a record inserted in the 'future'. A value of 0 denotes that the variable is not set. This variable is a no-op in non-debug builds.

rocksdb_debug_ttl_snapshot_ts.desc: For debugging purposes only.  Sets the snapshot during compaction to now() + debug_set_ttl_snapshot_ts.  The value can be +/- to simulate a snapshot in the past vs a snapshot created in the 'future'. A value of 0 denotes that the variable is not set. This variable is a no-op in non-debug builds.

rocksdb_enable_bulk_load_api.desc: Enables using SstFileWriter for bulk loading (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-enable-bulk-load-api to disable.)

rocksdb_enable_insert_with_update_cachin.desc: Whether to enable optimization where we cache the read from a failed insertion attempt in INSERT ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-enable-insert-with-update-caching to disable.)

rocksdb_enable_iterate_bounds.desc: Enable rocksdb iterator upper/lower bounds in read options. (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-enable-iterate-bounds to disable.)

rocksdb_enable_remove_orphaned_dropped_c.desc: Enables removing dropped cfs from metadata if it doesn't exist in cf manager (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-enable-remove-orphaned-dropped-cfs to disable.)

rocksdb_enable_thread_tracking.desc: DBOptions::enable_thread_tracking for RocksDB (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-enable-thread-tracking to disable.)

rocksdb_enable_ttl.desc: Enable expired TTL records to be dropped during compaction. (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-enable-ttl to disable.)

rocksdb_enable_ttl_read_filtering.desc: For tables with TTL, expired records are skipped/filtered out during processing and in query results. Disabling this will allow these records to be seen, but as a result rows may disappear in the middle of transactions as they are dropped during compaction. Use with caution. (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-enable-ttl-read-filtering to disable.)

rocksdb_error_on_suboptimal_collation.desc: Raise an error instead of warning if a sub-optimal collation is used

rocksdb_fault_injection_options.desc: Fault injection options for running rocksdb tests

rocksdb_flush_log_at_trx_commit.desc: Sync on transaction commit. Similar to innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit. 1: sync on commit, 0,2: not sync on commit

rocksdb_force_compute_memtable_stats.desc: Force to always compute memtable stats (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-force-compute-memtable-stats to disable.)

rocksdb_force_compute_memtable_stats_cac.desc: Time in usecs to cache memtable estimates

rocksdb_force_flush_memtable_and_lzero_n.desc: Acts similar to force_flush_memtable_now, but also compacts all L0 files.

rocksdb_force_flush_memtable_now.desc: Forces memstore flush which may block all write requests so be careful

rocksdb_force_index_records_in_range.desc: Used to override the result of records_in_range() when FORCE INDEX is used.

rocksdb_hash_index_allow_collision.desc: BlockBasedTableOptions::hash_index_allow_collision for RocksDB (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-hash-index-allow-collision to disable.)

rocksdb_ignore_unknown_options.desc: Enable ignoring unknown options passed to RocksDB (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-ignore-unknown-options to disable.)

rocksdb_info_log_level.desc: Filter level for info logs to be written mysqld error log. Valid values include 'debug_level', 'info_level', 'warn_level''error_level' and 'fatal_level'.

rocksdb_is_fd_close_on_exec.desc: DBOptions::is_fd_close_on_exec for RocksDB (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-is-fd-close-on-exec to disable.)

rocksdb_large_prefix.desc: Support large index prefix length of 3072 bytes. If off, the maximum index prefix length is 767. (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-large-prefix to disable.)

rocksdb_lock_scanned_rows.desc: Take and hold locks on rows that are scanned but not updated

rocksdb_lock_wait_timeout.desc: Number of seconds to wait for lock

rocksdb_manual_compaction_bottommost_lev.desc: Option for bottommost level compaction during manual compaction

rocksdb_manual_compaction_threads.desc: How many rocksdb threads to run for manual compactions

rocksdb_manual_wal_flush.desc: DBOptions::manual_wal_flush for RocksDB (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-manual-wal-flush to disable.)

rocksdb_master_skip_tx_api.desc: Skipping holding any lock on row access. Not effective on slave.

rocksdb_max_bottom_pri_background_compac.desc: Creating specified number of threads, setting lower CPU priority, and letting Lmax compactions use them. Maximum total compaction concurrency continues to be capped to rocksdb_max_background_compactions or rocksdb_max_background_jobs. In addition to that, Lmax compaction concurrency is capped to rocksdb_max_bottom_pri_background_compactions. Default value is 0, which means all compactions are under concurrency of rocksdb_max_background_compactions|jobs. If you set very low rocksdb_max_bottom_pri_background_compactions (e.g. 1 or 2), compactions may not be able to keep up. Since Lmax normally has 90 percent of data, it is recommended to set closer number to rocksdb_max_background_compactions|jobs. This option is helpful to give more CPU resources to other threads (e.g. query processing).

rocksdb_max_compaction_history.desc: Track history for at most this many completed compactions. The history is in the INFORMATION_SCHEMA.ROCKSDB_COMPACTION_HISTORY table.

rocksdb_max_latest_deadlocks.desc: Maximum number of recent deadlocks to store

rocksdb_max_manual_compactions.desc: Maximum number of pending + ongoing number of manual compactions.

rocksdb_max_row_locks.desc: Maximum number of locks a transaction can have

rocksdb_merge_buf_size.desc: Size to allocate for merge sort buffers written out to disk during inplace index creation.

rocksdb_merge_combine_read_size.desc: Size that we have to work with during combine (reading from disk) phase of external sort during fast index creation.

rocksdb_merge_tmp_file_removal_delay_ms.desc: Fast index creation creates a large tmp file on disk during index creation.  Removing this large file all at once when index creation is complete can cause trim stalls on Flash.  This variable specifies a duration to sleep (in milliseconds) between calling chsize() to truncate the file in chunks.  The chunk size is  the same as merge_buf_size.

rocksdb_no_create_column_family.desc: Do not allow creation of new Column Families through index comments.

rocksdb_override_cf_options.desc: option overrides per cf for RocksDB

rocksdb_paranoid_checks.desc: DBOptions::paranoid_checks for RocksDB (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-paranoid-checks to disable.)

rocksdb_partial_index_sort_max_mem.desc: Maximum memory to use when sorting an unmaterialized group for partial indexes. 0 means no limit.

rocksdb_perf_context_level.desc: Perf Context Level for rocksdb internal timer stat collection

rocksdb_persistent_cache_size_mb.desc: Size of cache in MB for BlockBasedTableOptions::persistent_cache for RocksDB

rocksdb_pin_l0_filter_and_index_blocks_i.desc: pin_l0_filter_and_index_blocks_in_cache for RocksDB (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-pin-l0-filter-and-index-blocks-in-cache to disable.)

rocksdb_print_snapshot_conflict_queries.desc: Logging queries that got snapshot conflict errors into *.err log

rocksdb_read_free_rpl.desc: Use read-free replication on the slave (i.e. no row lookup during replication). Default is OFF, PK_SK will enable it on all tables with primary key. PK_ONLY will enable it on tables where the only key is the primary key (i.e. no secondary keys).

rocksdb_read_free_rpl_tables.desc: Regex that describes set of tables that will use read-free replication on the slave (i.e. not lookup a row during replication)

rocksdb_records_in_range.desc: Used to override the result of records_in_range(). Set to a positive number to override

rocksdb_reset_stats.desc: Reset the RocksDB internal statistics without restarting the DB.

rocksdb_rollback_on_timeout.desc: Whether to roll back the complete transaction or a single statement on lock wait timeout (a single statement by default)

rocksdb_rpl_skip_tx_api.desc: Use write batches for replication thread instead of tx api

rocksdb_seconds_between_stat_computes.desc: Sets a number of seconds to wait between optimizer stats recomputation. Only changed indexes will be refreshed.

rocksdb_skip_bloom_filter_on_read.desc: Skip using bloom filter for reads

rocksdb_skip_fill_cache.desc: Skip filling block cache on read requests

rocksdb_skip_locks_if_skip_unique_check.desc: Skip row locking when unique checks are disabled.

rocksdb_stats_level.desc: Statistics Level for RocksDB. Default is 1 (kExceptHistogramOrTimers)

rocksdb_stats_recalc_rate.desc: The number of indexes per second to recalculate statistics for. 0 to disable background recalculation.

rocksdb_store_row_debug_checksums.desc: Include checksums when writing index/table records

rocksdb_strict_collation_check.desc: Enforce case sensitive collation for MyRocks indexes (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-strict-collation-check to disable.)

rocksdb_strict_collation_exceptions.desc: Regex that describes set of tables that are excluded from the case sensitive collation enforcement

rocksdb_table_stats_max_num_rows_scanned.desc: The maximum number of rows to scan in table scan based cardinality calculation

rocksdb_table_stats_recalc_threshold_cou.desc: Number of modified rows to trigger stats recalculation

rocksdb_table_stats_recalc_threshold_pct.desc: Percentage of number of modified rows over total number of rows to trigger stats recalculation

rocksdb_table_stats_sampling_pct.desc: Percentage of entries to sample when collecting statistics about table properties. Specify either 0 to sample everything or percentage [1..100]. By default 10% of entries are sampled.

rocksdb_table_stats_use_table_scan.desc: Enable table scan based index calculation.

rocksdb_tmpdir.desc: Directory for temporary files during DDL operations.

rocksdb_trace_block_cache_access.desc: Block cache trace option string. The format is sampling_frequency:max_trace_file_size:trace_file_name. sampling_frequency and max_trace_file_size are positive integers. The block accesses are saved to the rocksdb_datadir/block_cache_traces/trace_file_name.

rocksdb_trace_queries.desc: Trace option string. The format is sampling_frequency:max_trace_file_size:trace_file_name. sampling_frequency and max_trace_file_size are positive integers. The queries are saved to the rocksdb_datadir/queries_traces/trace_file_name.

rocksdb_trace_sst_api.desc: Generate trace output in the log for each call to the SstFileWriter

rocksdb_track_and_verify_wals_in_manifes.desc: DBOptions::track_and_verify_wals_in_manifest for RocksDB (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-track-and-verify-wals-in-manifest to disable.)

rocksdb_two_write_queues.desc: DBOptions::two_write_queues for RocksDB (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-two-write-queues to disable.)

rocksdb_unsafe_for_binlog.desc: Allowing statement based binary logging which may break consistency

rocksdb_validate_tables.desc: Verify all DD tables match all RocksDB tables (0 means no verification, 1 means verify and fail on error, and 2 means verify but continue

rocksdb_verify_row_debug_checksums.desc: Verify checksums when reading index/table records

rocksdb_wal_recovery_mode.desc: DBOptions::wal_recovery_mode for RocksDB. Default is kPointInTimeRecovery

rocksdb_whole_key_filtering.desc: BlockBasedTableOptions::whole_key_filtering for RocksDB (Defaults to on; use --skip-rocksdb-whole-key-filtering to disable.)

rocksdb_write_batch_flush_threshold.desc: Maximum size of write batch in bytes before flushing. Only valid if rocksdb_write_policy is WRITE_UNPREPARED. 0 means no limit.

rocksdb_write_batch_max_bytes.desc: Maximum size of write batch in bytes. 0 means no limit.
